title: Executive assistant,Lead Follow-Up & CRM Assistant (GoHighLevel), plus Social Media/Video
description:
We're a fast-growing US lighting company. We run a national brand of permanent LED lighting sold through a network of professional installers, plus a local holiday lighting installation business. Hundreds of contractors have applied to join our installer program, and we need one reliable person to make sure every one of them gets followed up with. No lead gets missed.



This is NOT a phone role. The owner handles all Sales calls. Your job is everything around the calls, so he can spend his time selling. You may be asked to answer some calls to gather info but no major phone conversations. Owner is looking for a longer term fit with increasing wages over time. The more of an executive assistant and hats you can wear saving the business owner time the more you will be evaluated for bonuses and pay increases. 



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Lead pipeline (your #1 priority, every day):



Work through our backlog of about 500 installer applications. Research each business (website, reviews, years in business), rank them using our criteria, and log everything in GoHighLevel.

Send personal follow-ups by text and
, and keep following up until every applicant either books a call with the owner or is closed out.

Make sure every lead in the pipeline has a stage, a next step and a due date.

Send an end-of-day report: what you finished, what needs the owner, and anything you're stuck on.



Inbox and installer questions:



Answer common installer questions by text and
 using our FAQ.

Pass anything technical to the owner. Never guess.

Keep the inboxes organized so nothing sits unanswered.



Admin support:



Help with order updates and scheduling for our local installation business.



Content (once the pipeline is handled):



Post and schedule social media content, and make graphics in Canva.

Edit short videos (Reels, TikTok, Shorts) and longer YouTube and training videos.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Every new application gets contacted within 1 business day.

Zero leads go 7+ days without contact.

An end-of-day report every single day.



MUST HAVE



1+ year of hands-on GoHighLevel experience: pipelines, conversations inbox, smart lists, tasks, SMS/email

Experience with written customer support or CRM management

Excellent written English in a plain, friendly, casual tone. Our customers are American contractors.

Obsessive about details and follow-through

At least 4 hours of overlap with 9am–5pm US Central time, Monday to Friday

Reliable internet, plus backup power and a backup internet connection



NICE TO HAVE



Video editing (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut or Descript)

Experience working with roofing, solar or other home-service companies

Comfortable using ChatGPT or Claude to work faster, along with any other ai tool automations and workflow building experience that is related.

Shopify experience

Business Growth Experience, and drive for more trust with business operations 



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the words "Nothing slips." Then answer these three questions in your own words:



How would you make sure no lead in a GoHighLevel pipeline goes 7 days without being contacted?

A contractor texts us: "Hey, what's the deal with your installer program? Is there a fee?" You don't know the answer yet. Write the exact reply you would send.

Are you working for any other clients right now? If yes, how many hours?



Also include:



A link to a short screen recording or screenshots of GoHighLevel work you've done

A video portfolio link, if you edit video



Top candidates will do a short paid trial task before we hire. Applications that don't follow these instructions won't be reviewed.

title: Virtual Producer & Content Pipeline Manager ($800 - $1,000 USD/mo)
description:
FULL-TIME: 

Salary: $800 - $1,000 USD/month (depending on experience) + Performance increases. Hours: Full-Time (40 hours/week)



The Role:

I am a Real Estate Division Director in Singapore. I have a fully equipped studio, the industry expertise, and all the AI tools. What I do not have is the desire to sit alone in an empty room trying to project energy into a dead camera lens.



I am looking for a full-time Virtual Producer and showrunner. This is not a passive Video Editor or standard Virtual Assistant role. I need an assertive, intelligent pipeline manager who will tell me where to sit, what we are talking about today, and hold me accountable to producing content.



Who You Are:

You are a sparring partner, not an order-taker. If you need to be told exactly what to do every step of the way, you will fail here. I need someone sharp enough to hold a conversation and push back when needed.

You know how to "manage up." You are not intimidated by a busy boss. If I am making excuses or missing deadlines, you are comfortable calling me out and getting us back on track.

You are a systems thinker. You know how to take one piece of core content and turn it into ten pieces of micro-content using AI.



What You Will Do:

The Prep (Research): You will use AI to scrape competitor content and trends, extract what works, and build simple ad-lib outlines for me (Hook, 3 Main Points, Data/Evidence, Call to Action). No word-for-word teleprompter scripts. You must be smart enough to know when AI output is generic garbage and refine it into a sharp angle.



The Shoot (Directing): 

This is the most important part. You will be on Zoom/Riverside with me live while I shoot. You will ask me the questions, direct the flow, and give me a real human to talk to so the energy stays high.



The Multiplication (Post-Production): 

After the shoot, you own the distribution matrix. You will use AI tools to chop the video into clips, write LinkedIn posts, draft
 newsletters, and format captions for my final approval.



The Onboarding (The "Taste Transfer"):

We won't guess what works. For the first month, we will have a daily Zoom call where we review competitor videos together. I will tell you exactly what I love and what I hate until my "taste" becomes your taste.



How to Apply (READ CAREFULLY):

I do not care about generic cover letters or standard CVs. To apply, you must submit exactly two things:



A 1-to-2 minute Loom video. In this video, look at the camera and tell me exactly how you would handle a boss who constantly makes excuses for why they haven't filmed their content this week.



A Sample Outline. Find one real estate or business short-form video on TikTok/Instagram that performed well. Send me the link to the video, and below it, break it down into the outline format I need: Hook, 3 Main Points, Evidence, Call to Action.



Applications missing either of these two items will be immediately archived

title: iPad Wedding Invitation Content Creator / Designer
description:
We are looking for a talented and creative person to create beautiful behind-the-scenes videos showing digital wedding invitation templates being put together on an iPad.



This is a long-term opportunity for someone who has a strong eye for design, understands aesthetics, and enjoys creating satisfying, premium-looking social media content.



The style and quality of content we are looking for is similar to:











Please look through these pages before applying so you fully understand the type of videos, filming style and overall aesthetic we are looking for.



The invitation templates are already designed and built.



You will be provided with the finished design and all of the elements required, including:



- Images

- Graphics

- Fonts

- Colours

- Text

- Decorative elements

- Final design reference



You do not need to research or create every design from scratch.



Your main job is to take the provided elements and recreate the finished invitation on your iPad while filming the process beautifully.



The videos may show things such as:



- Moving elements into position

- Adding typography

- Adjusting text

- Adding photos

- Changing or adjusting colours

- Resizing elements

- Adjusting spacing

- Using the Apple Pencil

- Building the design piece by piece

- Showing the completed invitation at the end



We want the process to feel natural, satisfying and beautiful to watch.



A good understanding of wedding invitations and design is a big advantage.



We would love someone who understands:



- Good colour combinations

- Typography and font pairing

- Layout and spacing

- Visual hierarchy

- Wedding aesthetics

- Modern invitation styles

- Luxury, editorial and minimal design

- What currently looks attractive on Instagram, TikTok and Pinterest



Although the finished designs will already be provided, we want someone with a good eye who can notice when something could look better and help with small design decisions where needed.



If you are also capable of creating new invitation templates in the future, that is a big bonus and may lead to additional work.



FILMING SETUP



The filming setup is extremely important.



Before we move forward with your application, we want you to show us EXACTLY how you would set everything up if you got this job.



Please do not just send a random photo of your desk or equipment.



Actually prepare the full filming scene exactly as if you were about to record one of our videos.



We want to see:



- Exactly where the iPad would be positioned

- The exact camera angle you would use

- Where your hands would be

- How you would use the Apple Pencil

- Your desk or table

- Your full background

- The lighting

- Any props or decorative objects you would include

- How everything would be positioned inside the final video frame



Everything visible in the video should be well placed and intentional.



We are looking for:



- A clean and aesthetic background

- Beautiful lighting

- Good camera quality

- A professional camera angle

- A clean desk

- Well-positioned objects

- Good composition

- A premium overall look



We want to see exactly what the final videos would look like if you were hired.



HOW TO APPLY



When applying, please prepare the actual setup you would use for the job and send:



1. A photo showing the complete filming setup from the exact camera angle you would use.

2. A short video filmed from that exact setup so we can see the camera quality, lighting, background and overall aesthetic.

3. Show your iPad and Apple Pencil in the setup so we can see how the actual filming would look.

4. Tell us which iPad you use.

5. Tell us which phone or camera you use.

6. Send examples of your design work.

7. Send examples of any aesthetic videos or social media content you have created before.



We care a lot about attention to detail, taste and overall presentation.



You do not need to have a huge portfolio. If your setup looks beautiful and you clearly have a strong eye for design, we are interested.



TEST TASK



If we like your setup and application, you will move to the next stage.



Message me and I will send you the actual invitation elements and finished reference design for the test.



You will then recreate the supplied invitation on your iPad and film a short sample showing the process.



You will not need to invent a new design.



Everything required for the test will be provided.



We will mainly be looking at:



- Your filming setup

- Lighting

- Camera quality

- Background

- Composition

- Attention to detail

- How naturally you use the iPad and Apple Pencil

- Accuracy of the recreated design

- Overall aesthetic

- How satisfying and premium the final video feels



LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



We are looking for someone we can work with long term.



If you are talented, reliable and consistently produce beautiful work, there will be opportunities to take on more responsibility over time.



If you are also good at design, there may be additional opportunities to help create new invitation templates, improve existing designs and contribute your own creative ideas.



There is also an additional earning opportunity on top of the normal salary.



You will have the option to promote the product yourself through your own TikTok, Instagram, Pinterest or other social media accounts.



You can earn commission for every sale you personally generate.



The more sales you generate, the more you can earn.



This means someone who becomes very good at creating this type of wedding content can potentially earn significantly more on top of their normal pay.



The affiliate side is optional, but there is a big opportunity for someone who understands wedding content, social media and what customers like.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the business, improve their skills and potentially become an important part of the creative side of the company.





PAY & EARNING OPPORTUNITY



This role includes a guaranteed base payment of A$200 per month, plus the opportunity to earn significantly more through sales commissions.

The base payment covers the regular invitation content we provide for you to recreate and film.



On top of this, you can earn commission for every customer you personally bring to the business.



If you enjoy TikTok, Instagram, Pinterest or creating wedding content, you can also market the product yourself using your own content.



You will have your own tracking link/code so the sales you generate can be tracked.



The more sales you generate, the more you earn.



There is no fixed limit on the commission side.



We are especially interested in finding someone who sees this as more than just a small monthly job.



If you are good at creating beautiful wedding content, understand what brides like, and learn how to generate views and sales, there is an opportunity to build a much larger monthly income alongside the guaranteed base payment.



You will already have access to the designs, invitation content and product to create content around, so you do not need to build something from nothing.



If you are also talented at designing wedding invitations, there may be additional paid opportunities in the future to help create new templates and ideas.



We want someone who can grow with the business and benefit as the business grows.

title: Marketing & Content Coordinator - Moving Company
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE.

We’re looking for a marketing & content coordinator to manage the daily execution of our marketing efforts. 

You will turn real moving footage, customer questions, and approved marketing ideas into consistent content that builds trust and generates qualified leads. This is not an editor role! You will send content to editor and review before you send to us. 

 Platforms you will be in charge of are IG & FB/TikTok/YT Shorts, Reddit , Website blog posts, Google Biz profile & Yelp. 

Remote & Full Time

 MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Content Planning 

 A. Maintain content calendar with topics, deadlines, approvals, and publishing dates. 

 B. Gather recurring client FAQ’s to develop content ideas.

 C. Keep footage, photos, draft, and published link organized.

2. Social Media and Video Coordination

 A. Collection and organized moving footage supplied by crew.

 B. Prepare clear briefs for video editor, including footage links, intended message, platforms, and deadlines.

 C. Track editing progress, coordinate revisions, check drafts for accuracy, brand consistency, and customer privacy.

 D. Write captions and schedule approve content for IG, TikTok, Youtube shorts 

 E. Monitor comments and messages, responded with approved guidelines, and pass important inquiries to Andrew

3. Website and Community Content 

 A. Draft helpful square-space blog posts about LA to SF Moving questions, prep tips, customer concerns etc.

 B. Submit blog posts to Edgar for approval, publish approved posts, and keep information current

 C. Draft useful reddit posts and answers, following community rules. Make it sounds natural, no need to disclose biz affiliation.

 D. Track inquiries generated by these channels and pass them to the sales department.

4. Business profiles and customer reviews 

 A. Keep Google business profile and yelp info accurate

 B. Add approved moving photos to both profile every two weeks. 

 C. Monitor reviews, draft replies, and publish responses after approval.

 D. Requests for reviews is handled by operations manger BUT you will track. 

5. Referral administration and reporting.

 A. Maintain a referral contact log with follow up dates.

 B. Support approved referral follow-ups and pass referred prospects to sales or Andrew.

 C. Prepare a concise weekly update covering plush content, upcoming work, reviews, channel performance, and decisions needed.

 D. Track qualified inquiries and use booking outcomes supplied by sales. 



QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience coordinating social media, content publishing, or digital marketing for a business.

- Strong written English and English comprehension.

- Strong organization, attentive to detail.

- Familiarity with IG, TikTok, YT Shorts, Reddit, and content scheduling tools.

- Ability to coordinate with a video editor to provide clear feedback

- Sound judgement about factual claims, customer privacy, and when to request approval.

- Experience with Squarespace. Google Biz profile, Reddit, Yelp, local-service marketing, and basic SEO 



WORKING RELATIONSHIP and AUTHORITY

You will manage routine scheduling, content organization, and factual profile updates within approved guidelines. Edgar/Andrew sets marketing strategy, ad budgets, brand direction, and approval requirements, new public claims, and sensitive responses.

 A sprat video editor handles video production. Sales calls, quotes, booking, dispatch, payments, and job accounting belong to their respective roles.

 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE.

- Approved Content is published consistently according the agreed calendar.

- The editor receives organized footage and clear briefs.

- Business profiles, stays accurate and current.

- Checking review request to remind operations manager.

- Every sales inquiry from these social media channels reach sales team

- Weekly reporting shows which efforts generated qualified inquiries and booked moves. 



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit the following

- Resume and short intro describing your relevant experience and how you keep content work organized

- 2-3 relevant work samples. For example a content calendar, editor brief, a video, blog posts or social media account you help manage.

- Your weekly ability and hours available for work. 

- A formal portfolio! This is brownie points. I would love to see viewable links, visuals, screenshots, pdf. Etc.



Only shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete the paid test ($5)

title: META ADS SPECIALIST - Paid Social for Car Tech Brand (Long-term, Monthly Retainer)
description:
META ADS SPECIALIST - Paid Social for Car Tech Brand (Long-term, Monthly Retainer)



ABOUT US

We run a fast-growing e-commerce brand selling smartphone integration modules (wireless Apple CarPlay / Android Auto) for BMW, Mercedes and Audi. We sell across the US, UK and Europe and run 5-figure monthly ad spend on Meta. The founder runs every campaign personally - you start as his right hand on the account, and the role grows from there.



THE JOB

You start as a helper on the account: daily monitoring, uploading creatives, building ad sets to our specs, keeping tracking healthy. Show results and you grow into running the monitoring fully, with your own test campaigns and budget.



- Daily account check with a short read: what moved, what to watch, what you recommend and why

- Prepare launches: upload creatives, build ad sets to our specs, name things properly

- Fix and maintain tracking health: Events Manager, Conversions API, deduplication. This is your first real project and we measure it against our real sales numbers

- Audit our Meta ad account and tell us what we're missing - this is how you get hired

- Weekly summary: results, learnings, what to test next



We provide EVERYTHING: full account history, our testing doctrine and decision rules, proven creatives and scripts, past performance data, and a founder who answers fast.



The hard part of this job is not launching campaigns. It's knowing when to do nothing - reading one bad day and telling noise from a real problem, holding when holding is right, and being honest the moment something you launched isn't working. If you can admit a losing test faster than we spot it, you'll do very well here.



HOURS & PAY

About 1 hour per day, Monday to Sunday - the account runs daily, so do we

Start as a helper on the account - €300/month

Grow into monitoring it fully - €500/month and growing from there

Paid weekly via Wise



REQUIREMENTS

- 2+ years running Meta ads for e-commerce stores specifically - not lead gen, not local businesses

- Proven results you can show with context - account screenshots, case breakdowns, references. Show us, don't tell us

- You understand iOS tracking loss, attribution windows and CAPI, and can explain them in plain words

- Able to make small calls alone and flag big ones before touching anything

- Comfortable using AI to work faster, and smart enough to know when not to trust it

- Strong English, reachable on WhatsApp



TO APPLY

1. Describe one e-commerce account you scaled - starting point, what you changed, the result with numbers

2. Answer this: a store's real sales are double what Meta reports. What are the first three things you check?

3. Tell us your expected monthly rate for this scope

4. Start your application with the word PIXEL so we know you read this

We manage short-term and long-term rentals in southern Oregon, USA. We are hiring one full-time person to own the short-term rental side: guest communication, turnovers, and solving problems the day they happen.



THE SCHEDULE, IN MANILA TIME:

Saturday 3:00 AM to 11:00 AM

Sunday 1:00 AM to 9:00 AM

Monday 1:00 AM to 9:00 AM

Tuesday 3:00 AM to 11:00 AM

title: Full-Time Video Editor (Ecom Ads)
description:
Full-Time Video Editor (Psychology-First Ecom Ads)



Location: Remote



Type: Part Time to start, Full time if it’s a strong fit.



Full Time Salary: $1,500 /month + Bonuses



Future Earnings Potential: $5,000–$6,000/month as you grow into a producer–marketer hybrid



BONUS: You've been through courses like EcomTalent.



We Don’t Care If It’s Pretty. We Care If It Performs.



We’re NOT hiring a “video editor.”



We’re hiring someone who wants to become a conversion machine.



Someone who wants to understand what makes people stop.



What makes them watch.



What makes them buy.



And what makes them say “take my money.”



If you obsess over human psychology more than fancy transitions, you’re exactly who we want.



We’re a brand that builds psychology-driven, data-led ad creatives in markets that have gotten too comfortable. 



Our editors don’t sit in a corner cutting clips — they help shape winners that help us scale from $10k/day to $50k/day.



Who You’re Joining



We’re not a deliverables brand.



We’re not a results-driven brand.



We’re a performance psychology lab disguised as a creative team.



We don’t sell videos.



We sell outcomes created through psychological precision.



And the proof?



In January, we tripled our second brand’s revenue in seven days using only the first 8 ads we launched.



Not after months of creative testing.



Not after 30 variations.



Eight ads.



First week.



Tripled revenue.



And now we’re going to do it again.



You won’t be pushing pixels.



You’ll be pushing psychology.



Your Role



As our editor, your mission is simple.



Turn raw footage into scroll-stopping, high-intent, brain-triggering direct-response creatives.



You will be editing AI UGC, VO-led scripts, testimonial ads, and B-roll performance creatives.



You will be working directly with our head strategist to bring concepts to life.



You will be understanding why specific cuts change human behavior.



You will be prioritising attention ? interest ? desire ? action.



You will be iterating based on performance data, not opinion.



If it’s ugly but converts, that’s a win.



If it’s beautiful but doesn’t, it goes in the bin.



What You Need to Be Good At



Editing with intention, not ego.



Understanding consumer behaviour, objections, and emotional triggers.



Working fast — speed is a skill. 



Applying feedback rooted in data.



Using Premiere Pro, CapCut, Final Cut, or any tool that delivers performance.



What We Don’t Want



Editors who care more about clean timelines than clean CPA.



People who over-edit until the message dies.



Portfolio divas who want everything looking like a film trailer.



Anyone unwilling to learn marketing psychology.



This job is not for aesthetic-focused editors.



This is for editors who want to sell with a timeline.



Ideal Candidate



Experience with DTC, UGC, or performance creatives.



You think like a marketer first, an editor second.



You understand hooks, retention curves, and drop-off psychology.



Bonus if you study ads the way filmmakers study films.



We Will Turn You Into a Marketer — Not Just an Editor



You’ll get access to the EcomTalent Course – The gold standard for aspiring creative strategists.



You’ll get internal creative strategy training.



You’ll get deep psychology-based marketing breakdowns.



Within months, you won’t just edit.



You’ll strategise, concept, and produce winning ads.



Why Join Us?



You’ll work with top-level strategists, creators, and growth operators.



You’ll learn real marketing psychology — the one skill that makes editors irreplaceable.



You’ll have massive long-term earning and career upside.



How to Apply



Send me your ecom portfolio.



With your name and 4-5 sentences on what DRIVES you.



No CV



No Resume

title: Sales Team lead
description:
Senior BDR / Campaign Lead / Sales Lead

Hands-on outbound sales and core team management responsibilities



URGENT HIRING  Immediate or short-notice availability strongly preferred

Qore Team | Remote | Long-term independent contractor | UK business hours

We welcome applications from Philippines-based professionals. The gross contractor fee is negotiable according to relevant experience, capability and agreed scope.



About Qore Team

Qore Team provides outsourced marketing and sales-development services and is expanding into remote IT support. We help businesses build their pipelines, strengthen their marketing and deliver dependable services. We are growing our remote team, initially focused on the UK, with Australia in our wider plans.



The opportunity

We need an experienced business development professional who can build a repeatable outbound pipeline while managing and improving a small sales team. You will personally prospect and nurture opportunities, coach junior colleagues, and take responsibility for campaign execution and quality. Team management is a core requirement. The initial priority is Qore’s own growth, with responsibility for outsourced client campaigns as agreed.

Reports to the Managing Director. Leads and develops the sales-development team and works closely with marketing.

You will contribute directly to a growing business, help shape practical ways of working and see the impact of your work. Priorities may change as the business develops; we will agree achievable responsibilities and delivery expectations.



Key responsibilities

Build and develop sales pipelines

• Define target customer profiles, research accounts and decision-makers, and build accurate, prioritised prospect lists.

• Run outbound activity through cold calling, personalised
 and LinkedIn. Qualify needs, business fit, buying process and realistic timing; progress prospects to an appropriate next step.

• Build nurture sequences for prospects who are not ready to buy. Maintain clear next actions, ownership and follow-up dates so viable opportunities are not lost.

• Create and improve CRM stages, qualification criteria, handoff standards and pipeline reports. Review ageing opportunities, conversion rates and forecast assumptions.



Manage and develop the team

• Set clear campaign priorities and individual responsibilities. Manage the day-to-day delivery of junior BDRs and appointment setters alongside your own agreed sales activity.

• Onboard and train colleagues, run call reviews and role-plays, provide specific feedback, and document coaching actions and progress.

• Identify performance gaps early, agree improvement actions and escalate persistent issues to the Managing Director. Build usable playbooks, scripts and quality standards.



Lead campaigns and coordinate delivery

• Translate a brief into an outbound plan covering audience, messaging, channels, sequencing, workload and reporting. Test changes and explain what the evidence shows.

• Coordinate with marketing on messaging, content, lead quality and campaign feedback. Keep Qore and client campaign data, promises and priorities clearly separated.

• Provide concise progress reports and explain risks, blockers and recommended improvements. Support prospect handover and client campaign reviews where required.

• Use prospect data responsibly, respect opt-outs and follow approved outreach and security requirements. Pricing, contracts and final commercial commitments remain with the Managing Director.



Required skills and experience

• At least three years of relevant B2B outbound sales or business development experience, including at least one year managing or directly coaching a small sales-development team.

• Evidence of personally generating qualified meetings and opportunities, with clear reporting periods and an explanation of your contribution versus the team’s results.

• Demonstrated ability to build a pipeline from research through prospecting, qualification, nurturing and sales handover.

• Confident cold calling, objection handling and consultative questioning, plus excellent personalised outreach writing.

• Practical experience with a CRM such as Zoho CRM, HubSpot or Salesforce, and prospect research, sequencing and reporting tools.

• Very high written and spoken English proficiency. You must be able to coach colleagues, lead client conversations and write clear professional messages with minimal editing.

• A hands-on leadership style, sound judgement, reliable follow-through and the ability to prioritise in an early-stage business.

• Willingness and reliable availability to work UK business hours, including agreed prime calling and outreach periods.



Preferred experience

• Experience in an outsourced sales provider, lead-generation agency, BPO, MSP or other company delivering services for multiple clients.

• Experience selling B2B professional services, marketing, IT, managed services or SaaS into UK or Australian markets.

• Experience establishing sales processes or improving an underperforming campaign in a small or growing business.



What success looks like

Success means a well-managed team, accurate pipeline visibility, consistent follow-up and a growing flow of held, qualified meetings and accepted opportunities. We will agree targets based on campaign maturity, audience and resources. Meeting quality, conversion and coaching outcomes matter alongside activity levels.



Availability and contractor terms

Reliable availability during agreed UK business hours is essential, including adjustment when UK clocks change. Exact working windows and weekly hours will be agreed before the engagement begins. Tell us your earliest realistic start date and any availability constraints.

• This is a long-term independent contractor engagement. The gross fee, service scope, weekly hours, payment currency and invoicing terms will be agreed in writing. Any incentive arrangement must be agreed separately.

• You must independently manage and fund the legal, administrative, operational and financial responsibilities of providing your services: relevant registrations and permissions, tax returns and payments, bookkeeping, invoicing, applicable social contributions, insurance, healthcare and provision for time off.

• Provide and maintain your own suitable computer, headset, secure workspace, reliable internet and power, and practical backup arrangements. Include your normal equipment, connectivity, utilities, administration and operating costs in your quoted fee.

• No separate employee benefits, allowances or reimbursements are included unless agreed in writing or required by applicable law. Access to Qore or client systems and any campaign-specific costs will be agreed separately; do not incur expenditure on their behalf without approval.

• Organise your work independently to meet agreed outcomes, UK availability, confidentiality and security requirements. The written agreement and actual working arrangements must comply with applicable law; statutory rights and obligations cannot be waived by describing the engagement as contracting.



Apply now

Apply through this job board or
 recruitment at 
 with the role title in the subject line. Include:

• Your CV and a brief explanation of why this hands-on leadership role suits you.

• One recent campaign example: service sold, target market, channels, timeframe, personal results and team results. Include meetings held, qualified opportunities or revenue where you can substantiate them.

• The number of people you managed or coached and one specific example of improved performance.

• Your earliest start date, notice period, UK-hours availability, expected gross monthly contractor fee in PHP, GBP or USD, included weekly hours and any separately proposed incentive terms.



The selection process may include an interview, a short outbound role-play and discussion of a pipeline or team-coaching plan. Anonymise client information and do not send confidential material from previous organisations.



We are hiring urgently and reviewing applications as they arrive. Please make your availability and gross fee expectations clear in your application.

About Qore Team

Qore Team provides outsourced marketing and sales-development services and is expanding into remote IT support. We help businesses build their pipelines, strengthen their marketing and deliver dependable services. We are growing our remote team, initially focused on the UK, with Australia in our wider plans.



The opportunity

We are looking for a proactive Business Development Representative who can start useful conversations, qualify prospects and book appointments that progress into real sales opportunities. You will research and contact prospective business customers, develop your own prospect pipeline and follow up consistently. Initial work supports Qore’s growth, with outsourced client campaigns included when agreed.

Works with the Sales Lead and Managing Director, with regular collaboration with marketing.

You will contribute directly to a growing business, help shape practical ways of working and see the impact of your work. Priorities may change as the business develops; we will agree achievable responsibilities and delivery expectations.



Key responsibilities



Prospect and build your pipeline

• Research target businesses and decision-makers using approved sources. Check contact accuracy, company fit and the reason for outreach.

• Carry out cold calling, personalised
 and LinkedIn outreach during agreed UK business hours. Tailor the message to the prospect’s situation.

• Ask clear qualification questions, identify relevant needs and buying roles, handle common objections and agree a sensible next step.

• Build and maintain a pipeline of new, engaged, nurturing and qualified prospects. Use follow-up sequences and dated next actions to develop opportunities over time.



Book and support qualified appointments

• Book meetings with suitable prospects against agreed qualification criteria. Confirm the purpose, attendees and time zone, and provide a concise handover.

• Manage confirmations, reminders, rescheduling and no-show follow-up professionally. Track meetings held as well as meetings booked.

• Record prospect needs, objections, commitments and relevant context in the CRM. Flag opportunities requiring a senior conversation.

• Maintain accurate CRM records, deal stages and task lists. Report progress, challenges and feedback so the team can improve targeting and messaging.

• Participate in coaching, call reviews and campaign tests. Apply feedback and take responsibility for improving the quality of your own work.

• Follow approved data-handling and outreach practices, respect opt-outs and protect client information. Use approved pricing and claims; escalate negotiations and contractual commitments.



Required skills and experience

• At least one year of relevant B2B outbound sales, sales-development or appointment-setting experience with measurable results.

• Confidence initiating cold calls, asking qualification questions, handling objections and maintaining a professional conversation with decision-makers.

• Practical ability to build and develop a prospect pipeline, including systematic nurturing and follow-up beyond the first contact.

• Experience using a CRM and maintaining accurate contact records, activity notes, opportunity stages and next actions.

• Very high written and spoken English proficiency, including clear telephone communication and professional
 writing with minimal editing.

• Good research skills, attention to detail, resilience and the ability to balance a consistent outreach workload with meeting quality.

• Coachability, dependable remote communication and ownership of commitments. You must be comfortable with changing campaign priorities.

• Willingness and reliable availability to work UK business hours, including agreed prime calling and appointment-setting periods.



Preferred experience

• Experience with outsourced sales companies, lead-generation agencies, BPOs or service providers running campaigns for multiple clients.

• Experience contacting UK or Australian businesses and selling or introducing B2B services, IT, marketing or SaaS.

• Familiarity with Zoho CRM, HubSpot or Salesforce, prospecting databases, diallers and
-sequencing tools.



What success looks like

Success means suitable prospects attend well-qualified meetings, handovers give the next person useful context, and promising contacts receive timely follow-up. We will review meetings held, qualification acceptance, show rates, opportunity progression and CRM accuracy alongside agreed outreach activity.



Availability and contractor terms

The role is full time, 8 hours per day. However, for the right candidate we can be flexible. Reliable availability during agreed UK business hours is essential, including adjustment when UK clocks change. Exact working windows and weekly hours will be agreed before the engagement begins. Tell us your earliest realistic start date and any availability constraints.

• This is a long-term independent contractor engagement. The gross fee, service scope, weekly hours, payment currency and invoicing terms will be agreed in writing. 

• You must independently manage and fund the legal, administrative, operational and financial responsibilities of providing your services: relevant registrations and permissions, tax returns and payments, bookkeeping, invoicing, applicable social contributions, insurance, healthcare and provision for time off.

• Provide and maintain your own suitable computer, headset, secure workspace, reliable internet and power, and practical backup arrangements. Include your normal equipment, connectivity, utilities, administration and operating costs in your quoted fee.

• No separate employee benefits, allowances or reimbursements are included unless agreed in writing or required by applicable law. Access to Qore or client systems and any campaign-specific costs will be agreed separately; do not incur expenditure on their behalf without approval.

The written agreement and actual working arrangements must comply with applicable law; statutory rights and obligations cannot be waived by describing the engagement as contracting.



Apply now

title: Paralegal / Legal Assistant
description:
Senior Legal Assistant / Paralegal

Full-Time • Remote • Long-Term (US Law Firm)



Sheil Law Firm, a Denver, Colorado law firm, is hiring one senior legal assistant/paralegal to work directly with the attorney.



The firm is one attorney and this seat. There is no layer of management and nowhere for work to hide. When clients trust the firm, it will often be because of something you did.



Most clients come to us on one of the hardest days of their lives: a death in the family, a child in trouble at school, or another life-changing event. They will not remember the legal work. They will remember whether someone answered, whether it was right, and whether it was done on time.



Because of that, two things matter more than anything on your résumé:



Responsiveness

When a client or the attorney contacts you during your shift, you acknowledge it promptly, even if the answer is simply:



"Received. Working on it. I'll have an update by 3."



Silence is the fastest way to fail here.



Ownership

You take tasks to completion without being chased. If you hit a roadblock, you raise it immediately. If a deadline is at risk, the attorney hears it from you first.



“I was waiting to hear back" is not a status update. Following up is part of the job.



Beyond those two principles, the standard is simple: clients feel taken care of, work is accurate, and records stay current. If it isn't in the system, it didn't happen.



We hire for temperament as much as skill. If you need every task assigned, prioritized, and explained before you begin, this role is probably not a fit.



What You Get Back



We are building this firm and want someone who wants to build it with us.



Your work will be visible and meaningful. In return, you get an attorney who backs you, pays on time, values initiative, and rewards contribution. We are looking for someone who wants a seat they can grow into and keep for years.



Practice Areas



The paralegal will primarily support matters involving:



- Estate planning (wills, trusts, powers of attorney, healthcare directives)

- Probate and estate administration

- Guardianships and conservatorships

- Guardian ad Litem representation

- Juvenile, family, and paternity matters

- Education and special-needs advocacy

- Elder law and adult-protection matters



The firm may also handle selected matters in other practice areas, including personal injury, civil litigation, administrative proceedings, and related legal matters. The ideal candidate is comfortable learning new processes and supporting work across multiple practice areas as the firm's needs evolve.



Responsibilities



Documents

- Prepare estate planning documents from attorney notes and firm templates

- Draft court filings, GAL reports, correspondence, and other legal documents for attorney review

- Proofread and redline documents for accuracy and consistency

- Assemble signing packages and coordinate witness/notary logistics



Client Management

- Respond to client communications the same day

- Conduct intake calls and gather missing information

- Keep clients informed about the status of their matter

- Escalate issues requiring attorney judgment



Records and Systems

- Maintain complete and current client files across firm systems

- Create and update matters, contacts, and client records

- Save and organize documents using firm naming conventions

- Perform conflict checks

- File and organize matter-related
s



Court and Matter Preparation

- Calendar hearings, deadlines, reviews, and signings

- Prepare hearing files and summaries

- Organize records, exhibits, and case history

- Research and summarize materials as assigned



Billing and Reporting

- Enter time and expenses

- Assist with monthly billing

- Provide regular status updates on active matters



Other Responsibilities

• Support firm operations, marketing, social media, technology, and special projects as needed

• Help improve systems, processes, and client experience

• Perform other duties reasonably related to the operation and growth of the firm



You May Be a Strong Fit If



- You notice details others miss

- You can manage dozens of active files without losing track of deadlines

- You learn processes quickly and retain them

- The attorney can assign you a task and stop thinking about it

- Your first drafts need editing, not rewriting

- You communicate clearly and professionally

- You stay calm under pressure and own mistakes quickly

- You are looking for a long-term position, not your next position



Requirements



- 3+ years of legal assistant or paralegal experience, **or** a Bachelor of Laws/JD and membership in good standing with the Philippine Bar

- College degree

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Ability to manage deadlines and files with minimal supervision



Only applicants meeting all requirements will be considered.



Preferred



- Experience in estate planning, probate, family law, juvenile law, personal injury, or litigation support

- Experience with HubSpot, ClickUp, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, or legal practice-management software

- Comfort using AI tools for drafting, organization, and research



Schedule and Equipment



- Full-time, 40 hours per week

- Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Mountain Time.  In Manila that is 10pm–7am (11pm–8am from November to mid-March). We are stating that plainly up front rather than discovering a mismatch in month two. The schedule is fixed, and this has to be your only job.

- This must be your only job

- Work is performed on a firm computer via remote desktop

- Reliable high-speed internet with a backup connection

- Backup power source

- Quiet private workspace

- Webcam, headset, and dual-monitor setup



Compensation



- $6.00-$8.00 USD per hour to start, depending on experience, qualifications, and interview performance

- Paid biweekly

- Compensation reviews at 6 and 12 months

- Paid US holidays

- Paid time off after probation



We are more interested in finding the right person than the cheapest person. Exceptional candidates may start at the upper end of the range.



Confidentiality



You will handle sensitive information, including estate planning documents, financial records, and information involving minors.



All work is performed under the supervision of a licensed US attorney on firm systems. A confidentiality agreement is required. This position does not involve providing legal advice.



How to Apply



 with the subject line:



**SENIOR LEGAL — [Your Name]**



Include:



1. Your résumé

2. Confirmation that you can work 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Mountain Time and that this will be your only job

3. Your available start date and compensation expectations

4. Answers to the three questions below in your own words

5. A 60-second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why this role fits you



Questions



a. A client
s asking for a status update on her case. You check the file, the CRM, and the
 history. Nothing has been recorded in three weeks, and the attorney is in court all day. What do you do, and what do you write back to her?



b. You realize a deadline on one of your files passed last week. What do you do in the next hour?



c. You open a new client's file to draft her trust and find no folder in Drive, no matter in the case system, and an intake sheet with two different dates of birth. Nobody has assigned you anything. What do you do?



Shortlisted candidates will complete a brief paid skills assessment before a final interview. We reply to every finalist.

title: Part-time Video Editor and Social Media Content Manager
description:
Remote | Part-Time | Long-Term Opportunity



We are Golden Vista Construction, a residential renovation company based in British Columbia, Canada. We specialize in kitchen, bathroom and condo renovations, and we are looking for a creative, reliable person to help us turn our raw video footage into professional social media content.



What we're looking for



We want someone who can take raw video footage and turn it into finished content with minimal direction.



Your responsibilities will include:



- Editing short-form videos for Instagram Reels,
 Reels and YouTube Shorts

- Editing occasional longer YouTube videos

- Creating strong hooks that grab attention in the first few seconds

- Adding captions, text overlays, transitions, B-roll and graphics

- Creating thumbnails and cover images

- Writing or improving social media captions and video descriptions

- Repurposing one piece of footage into content for multiple platforms

- Scheduling and publishing approved content

- Helping identify good content opportunities from the footage we provide

- Eventually helping us plan content ideas and maintain a consistent posting schedule



Our goal



We are not looking to simply post more content.



Quality is more important to us than quantity.



Initially, our target is approximately 4–5 polished pieces of content per week.



The owner will batch-record renovation videos and provide raw footage. Your job is to take that footage and turn it into professional, educational and engaging content.



Our content focuses on topics such as:



- Kitchen renovations

- Bathroom renovations

- Condo renovations

- Basement renovations

- Renovation costs

- Before-and-after transformations

- Common renovation mistakes

- DIY advice

- Product and material comparisons

- Frequently asked homeowner questions

- Behind-the-scenes construction

- Lessons learned on real projects



Who we're looking for



You should have:



- Strong video-editing skills

- Experience creating Reels, Shorts or TikTok-style videos

- A good understanding of pacing, storytelling and viewer retention

- The ability to create attention-grabbing hooks

- Basic graphic-design and thumbnail skills

- Good written English

- Good communication and reliability

- The ability to work independently

- Attention to detail



Experience with construction, home improvement, real estate, interior design or contractor content would be a major advantage, but it is not required.



You must be willing to learn our industry and our brand.



Editing style



Our content should feel:



Professional. Educational. Authentic. Clean.



We do not want excessive effects or editing that makes the videos feel gimmicky.



Our goal is to establish Golden Vista Construction as a trusted renovation expert while creating content that homeowners actually find useful.



Compensation



Starting budget: up to C$500 per month, depending on experience, ability and expected hours.



This will initially be a part-time position.



For the right person, we are interested in building a long-term working relationship, with the potential for the role and compensation to grow as our content program grows.



Paid Editing Test



We will shortlist approximately three candidates.



Each shortlisted candidate will receive:



- The same raw Golden Vista Construction video footage

- The same instructions

- The same deadline

- The same paid test fee



We want to see how you approach the footage creatively rather than simply judging you from your résumé.



We will evaluate:



1. The opening hook

2. Storytelling and pacing

3. Editing quality

4. Captions, graphics and visual presentation

5. Understanding of the message

6. Creativity

7. How much direction you require



How to Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your location and time zone

3. Your expected monthly compensation for this position

4. Approximately how many hours per week you can provide within that budget

5. Links to 3 examples of short-form videos you personally edited

6. One example of a longer YouTube video, if available

7. The editing software you normally use

8. Any experience you have with construction, renovation, home improvement, real estate or similar industries



Please also answer this question:



If we gave you 20 minutes of raw footage from a kitchen renovation, how would you turn it into multiple pieces of social media content?



At the beginning of your application, write the words:



GOLDEN STANDARDS

STRESS-FREE RENOVATIONS



This lets us know you read the entire job posting rather than sending a generic application.

About Axya



Axya Global is a real estate and development company based in Toronto, Canada. We market pre-construction homes in the Greater Toronto Area, where competition is intense and qualified buyers matter.



Our ambition goes beyond selling properties. We want to understand how people live and help deliver homes that feel like an extension of them. Our long-term vision includes advancing construction through innovative modular and deployable structures.



We are looking for a performance marketer who brings strong judgment, takes ownership, and has a tremendous appetite to learn.



Your mission



Build and improve the system connecting our advertising, CRM, qualified appointments, and sales.



You should proactively identify opportunities, recommend changes, and execute within agreed budgets. We want someone who notices problems and opportunities before we have to point them out.



What you will own



- Google and Meta advertising: Build, launch, monitor, and improve campaigns. Manage targeting, search terms, negative keywords, bidding, budget pacing, ad copy, and creative testing.

- CRM feedback: Connect acquisition data and meaningful lead outcomes in Follow Up Boss to Google and Meta. Implement and validate tracking, working with specialist support where necessary.

- Funnel analysis: Identify where leads drop off between registration, contact, qualification, appointments, and sales. Work with our sales team to distinguish advertising problems from follow-up problems.

- Competitive research: Study competing ads, landing pages, messaging, and offers. Turn findings into practical opportunities for Axya.

- Testing and reporting: Maintain a prioritized testing plan and explain what changed, why, what happened, and what should happen next.



What we are looking for



- Proven hands-on experience managing both Google Ads and Meta Ads for lead generation.

- Evidence of improving lead quality and downstream outcomes.

- Experience building or improving landing pages.

- Working knowledge of GA4, Google Tag Manager, enhanced conversions for leads, Meta Conversions API, and CRM attribution.

- Experience implementing a CRM-to-ad-platform feedback loop beyond basic form-submission tracking.

- Strong written English and the ability to explain decisions clearly.

- Independent prioritization, dependable communication, and agreed overlap with EST working hours.



Experience with real estate, mortgages, home services, or other high-value purchases involving an offline sales process is valuable. Follow Up Boss, n8n, Make, Zapier, and API/webhook experience are advantages.



Learning and initiative matter



We expect you to stay current with platform changes, measurement developments, creative approaches, and useful tools.



Bring us ideas, explain the reasoning, and test them responsibly. Know when the evidence supports a change and when more data is needed.



We care about your ability to learn, apply, measure, and improve—not simply name the latest feature or tool.



How we will assess success



- Reliable tracking and clear visibility into lead quality.

- Better cost per qualified lead and qualified attended appointment.

- Acquisition costs that make sense.

- Useful experiments and proactive recommendations.

- Less founder involvement in routine advertising work.



How to apply



Include while applying:



1. Two relevant campaign examples: budget, timeframe, results, and your personal contribution.

2. A short explanation of a CRM feedback loop you implemented and how you verified it worked.

3. One thing you learned in the last 90 days, how you applied it, and what happened.





Keep examples specific. Anonymize confidential client information.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a small paid practical assessment using anonymized information or read-only access.

 Video Maker for
 Ads



We are looking for a full-time video ad maker who specializes in creating high-quality direct response video ads, VSLs, AI UGC-style videos, and b-roll ads for
 advertising.



This is not a basic editing job.



We need someone who can take a finished script, find strong b-roll clips, generate realistic AI human clips, create scroll-stopping visuals, and turn the video into a high-quality ad that feels engaging, believable, and professional.



You will be working on video sales letters, short-form b-roll ads, and AI UGC ads for our brand.

You will help create:

* Short-form
 ad videos

* B-roll ads using stock footage, online clips, and AI-generated visuals

* Direct response ads designed to hold attention and drive sales

You will be responsible for:



* Editing full VSL videos from provided scripts and voiceovers

* Finding relevant b-roll clips that match the script

* Editing videos that are meant to sell, not just look nice

* Making videos for
, TikTok, Instagram Reels, or similar platforms

/TikTok ad videos

Google Drive Reference Link:

This is a full-time position.



You will have weekends off.



We are looking for someone who can work consistently during the week and communicate clearly.



## Trial Phase



Every hire will start with a 2-week trial phase.



The purpose of this trial is to see if you are the right fit for the role.



During the 2-week trial, you will be expected to create as many high-quality video ads as possible while maintaining strong quality and consistency.



At the end of the 2-week trial, we will review:



* The quality of your edits

title: Mortgage Broker Assistant (Loan Processor) – Australian Residential Lending – Full-Time, Long-Term
description:
ABOUT US



We are an established mortgage broking firm based in Adelaide, South Australia. We help clients across Australia with residential home loans, mostly refinances, purchases and pre-approvals, plus some other lending. Our head broker has 7 years of broking experience and focuses on bringing in business, while our support team takes each file from the point a client commits through to settlement.

We are growing and are looking for a reliable, experienced assistant to join the team on a long-term, stable basis.



THE ROLE

You will work alongside our in-house team and take ownership of loan files from start to finish. Once a client has committed and documents are in, the file is yours to run, with the broker overseeing along the way. You will manage around 15-20 files at a time, and sometimes more, and help support our in-house staff where needed.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



 • Run borrowing capacity and serviceability scenarios and shop lender options using Quickli

 • Assess client income and prepare scenarios across multiple lenders

 • Build loan applications in Apply Online and our CRMs

 • Collect and check all required client documents so each application is complete and correct

 • Prepare and lodge loan applications with lenders

 • Get forms and disclosures signed by clients

 • Liaise with clients, banks and BDMs from lodgement through to settlement

 • Follow up on conditions, additional information requests and valuations

 • Keep every deal on track against client and settlement deadlines

 • Keep client records and file notes accurate and up to date in HubSpot and MyCRM

 • Provide friendly, professional customer service by phone,
 and messaging

 • Communicate clearly with the broker and team in Slack



ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS



 • Proven experience processing or lodging residential mortgages for Australian lenders, including dealing directly with banks and clients (we need someone who can hit the ground running)

 • Hands-on experience building applications in Apply Online or a similar mortgage application platform

 • Working knowledge of Australian lending concepts: serviceability, living expenses, documentation requirements, pre-approvals, refinancing and settlement processes

 • Strong attention to detail, with the ability to spot missing or inconsistent documents before lodgement

 • Excellent written and spoken English

 • Able to manage multiple files at once and prioritise deadlines without close supervision

 • Strong customer service skills, with a calm, professional manner with clients and lenders

 • Comfortable handling confidential client financial information and following security procedures (strong passwords, multi-factor authentication, no sharing of logins or documents outside our systems)

 • Reliable high-speed internet with a backup option (mobile data, secondary connection or power backup), plus a quiet, dedicated workspace and your own working computer



HIGHLY DESIRABLE



 • Experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM

 • Experience with MyCRM

 • Experience with Quickli or other mortgage scenario and borrowing capacity tools

 • Experience working with Australian banks, non-bank lenders and BDMs

 • Previous customer service or client-facing experience

 • Familiarity with Slack and remote team collaboration



TRAINING AND SUPPORT



We will train you on our own processes, systems and standards, so you do not need to know everything on day one. We want someone who already understands mortgage processing and can get up to speed quickly. You will have direct access to the broker and the in-house team.



WHAT WE OFFER



 • Full-time, long-term, stable role with an established Australian company

 • Opportunity to grow within the company

 • Supportive team and clear processes

 • Modern tools, including AI-assisted scenario tools



WORKING HOURS



Full-time, Monday to Friday, with hours that overlap Adelaide business hours. 



HOW TO APPLY



Please start your application with the words "Lodgement Experience" so we know you've read this post. Then send:

 1. Your resume

 2. A short summary of your experience with Australian mortgage lodgements, including which lenders and platforms you have used

 3. The systems you are experienced with (Apply Online, HubSpot, MyCRM, Quickli or similar)

 4. Roughly how many files you managed at one time in your last role

 5. Your availability and expected rate

 6. A screenshot of your internet speed test and a short description of your backup internet and power setup



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a video interview and a short practical task. 



Applications that do not follow these steps may not be reviewed.



Salary can vary depending on your skills and experience.



We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Podcast Booking & PR Assistant
description:
About the Project



I'm a personal trainer, author, and Christian wellness entrepreneur preparing to launch my new book, Move for Joy, on January 27, 2027.



Move for Joy is a faith-based fitness book designed to help women break the exhausting cycle of starting and stopping exercise by shifting the focus from discipline and perfection to motivation, sustainability, and joy.



I'm looking for a highly organized, proactive Podcast & Book Launch Coordinator to help me build and execute a podcast interview campaign leading up to and following the book launch.



This is a great opportunity for someone who loves podcasts, understands women's wellness and/or Christian audiences, and enjoys making things happen behind the scenes.



What You'll Do



Podcast Research & Outreach



-Research podcasts that align with Move for Joy and its target audience

-Build and maintain a database of approximately 50–75 relevant podcasts

-Identify podcast hosts, contact information, audience focus, and potential interview topics

-Prioritize high-fit shows rather than simply focusing on podcast size

-Personalize and send podcast pitches

-Track outreach, follow-ups, responses, bookings, and air dates

-Follow up with podcast hosts at appropriate intervals

-Identify new podcast opportunities throughout the campaign



Podcast Booking & Coordination



-Communicate with podcast hosts and producers

-Coordinate interview dates and times

-Send hosts the appropriate bio, headshot, book information, talking points, and links

-Make sure hosts have everything they need before recording

-Maintain an up-to-date podcast calendar

-Keep me informed about upcoming interviews and deadlines

-Help coordinate a concentrated group of podcast appearances around the January 27 launch



Launch Promotion



Help turn podcast appearances into promotional content by:



-Tracking when episodes go live

-Providing me with a weekly list of upcoming podcast appearances

-Gathering episode links and graphics from hosts

-Creating a simple promotional schedule for social media and

-Identifying strong quotes or clips that could be repurposed

-Helping coordinate a "podcast week" around the book launch



Campaign Timeline



October



-Build podcast database

-Research target audiences

-Develop outreach system and tracking spreadsheet

-Finalize pitch materials



November–December



-Conduct primary podcast outreach

-Send approximately 10–15 personalized pitches per week

-Follow up with potential hosts

-Schedule and coordinate interviews



December–January



-Coordinate recordings

-Prepare hosts with interview materials

-Confirm launch-related episode timing

-Build the launch-week podcast schedule



January 27, 2027



-Book launch

-Coordinate concentrated podcast promotion around launch week



February



-Continue podcast outreach

-Promote newly released episodes

-Pursue additional opportunities based on launch momentum



What I'm Looking For



You are:



-Extremely organized and detail-oriented

-A strong written communicator

-Comfortable writing personalized outreach
s

-Proactive—you don't need to be told what to do at every step

-Comfortable researching podcasts and identifying good audience fits

-Familiar with Google Sheets, Gmail, and basic project-management tools

-Comfortable communicating professionally with podcast hosts

-Interested in women's health, fitness, wellness, faith, or personal development

-Able to keep track of many moving pieces without dropping details



Bonus Skills



You don't need all of these, but they're a major plus:



-Previous podcast booking or PR experience

-Experience promoting a book or author

-Experience working with Christian podcasts or women's podcasts

-Experience with podcast guest outreach

-Social media experience

-Experience with Canva

-Experience creating launch calendars

-Existing knowledge of podcast research tools or databases



The Ideal Person

I'm looking for someone who can look at a podcast and say:



"This audience is a great fit for Kasey. Here's the specific conversation I'd pitch to this host."



You should be comfortable taking ownership of the process, keeping me organized, and proactively looking for opportunities.



Initial Responsibilities & Goals

-50–75 well-researched podcast prospects

-Consistent weekly outreach

-Personalized pitches

-Organized follow-up

-A growing calendar of confirmed interviews

-Several appearances concentrated around launch week

-Continued podcast opportunities in the months following launch

Part-time contract position

An hourly rate, or

A monthly project rate for the October–February campaign

-A brief introduction

-Your relevant experience with podcast outreach, PR, book launches, or virtual assistance

-Examples of podcast outreach you've done, if applicable

-Your hourly or project rate

-Your estimated weekly availability

-Three podcasts you think would be a great fit for Move for Joy and, in 1–2 sentences each, explain why

Please do not send a generic cover letter. I want to see how you think about finding the right audience and creating a compelling pitch.



I'm looking for someone who can potentially begin in October and stay through the book launch and post-launch campaign.

I am a CPA who uses Claude Code daily. I know what I want built. I need someone who can build it faster than I can, explain it clearly, and challenge my thinking.

Agent teams for my CFO advisory firm — client bookkeeping review, month-end packs, workpapers, client correspondence.

A personal operating system — calendar,

New products — turning the internal systems above into packaged offerings we can take to market.

**Requirements**



Hands-on with Claude Code (subagents, CLAUDE.md, skill files, MCP) and at least one other frontier model platform (Grok, OpenAI or Gemini). You can show working systems you have built.



Python or TypeScript to a working standard; Git daily; comfortable with APIs, OAuth and webhooks (Xero and Microsoft 365 a strong plus).



A genuine teacher. You can explain a technical decision to a smart non-engineer, live, without jargon — and you enjoy it.



Strong product sense. You will be expected to push back, suggest better approaches and bring ideas, not just take instructions.

n8n, Make or Zapier; Supabase/Postgres; Microsoft Graph API. Any exposure to accounting, bookkeeping or immigration processes. Open-model experience for cost-sensitive workloads.

Daily pairing session, then independent build time. Weekly written goals and a Friday demo. Everything in Git with a README. Secrets in a vault, never in chat. description:
About us



We build and operate CCTV for construction sites across Australia. We build the hardware and we build the software that runs it — live view, playback, alarm monitoring, onboarding, billing. Hundreds of cameras and 4G routers in the field, one platform running all of them.



The role



The platform is currently run by a core engineering team. You'll own real parts of the system end to end — write it, ship it, watch it run.



The work is broad: REST APIs and React one day, a camera that won't stream the next, a router dropping its VPN the day after. There's no separate devops or QA team. If that sounds like a mess, it's not for you. If it sounds interesting, keep reading.



Stack



Python 3.12 / FastAPI, React, MariaDB, self-hosted Linux (systemd, nginx), WireGuard, 4G routers, IP cameras over RTSP and ONVIF, WebRTC streaming.



What we need



Strong Python in production — you understand async, blocking calls, connection pools

Solid JavaScript or TypeScript, and you've shipped frontends

Real Linux experience — SSH into a sick server and work out what's wrong

Networking: NAT, VPNs, routing, firewalls. A lot of our debugging lives here

Willingness to work things out when there's no documentation. This matters more than any specific skill on this list



Nice to have (not required — we'll teach you if you are really smart)



RTSP, ONVIF, WebRTC, ffmpeg. CCTV hardware — Hikvision, Dahua, Uniview. 4G/LTE routers. LLM tool-use APIs.



What we're not



No big team, no product manager, no ticket queue. Some weeks are new features, some are firefighting. We want someone smart and curious, not someone who needs a spec handed to them.

title: EXPERIENCED QUICKBOOKS DESKTOP BOOKKEEPER – U.S. HOURS REQUIRED
description:
IMPORTANT: This position requires extensive hands-on experience with QUICKBOOKS DESKTOP and the ability to work U.S. Eastern Time hours from 10:00 AM to 6:30 PM, with a break for lunch.



If your bookkeeping experience is primarily QuickBooks Online using automated bank feeds and imported transactions, this position is probably not the right fit.



We need someone who is highly proficient in QuickBooks Desktop and comfortable performing traditional bookkeeping, including MANUALLY ENTERING transactions from bank statements and credit card statements when necessary.



WORK HOURS:



• Must be available to work 10:00 AM to 6:30 PM U.S. Eastern Time



• Break for lunch



• You must be consistently available and actively working during these hours



Responsibilities include:



• Entering transactions from bank and credit card statements into QuickBooks Desktop



• Properly coding transactions to general ledger accounts



• Reconciling bank and credit card accounts



• Reviewing the general ledger and identifying incorrect, duplicate, or missing transactions



• Preparing and maintaining accurate bookkeeping records



• Communicating clearly with our accounting team regarding missing information, discrepancies, and questions



Required Qualifications:



• Minimum 4 years of bookkeeping experience



• STRONG QuickBooks Desktop experience is REQUIRED



• Experience manually entering transactions from bank and credit card statements into QuickBooks Desktop



• QuickBooks Online experience is helpful, but QuickBooks Desktop proficiency is significantly more important for this position



• Strong working knowledge of accounting principles and practices



• Solid understanding of debits, credits, general ledger accounts, and proper transaction classification



• Experience performing bank and credit card reconciliations



• Excellent attention to detail



• Ability to learn and become proficient with new software applications



• Ability to meet deadlines and manage multiple client assignments



• Strong written and verbal English communication skills



• Two monitors are preferable for efficiency when working between QuickBooks Desktop and source documents



This is not simply a data-import position. We are specifically looking for an experienced bookkeeper who understands the accounting behind the entries and can work from actual bank and credit card statements when transactions cannot simply be downloaded or imported.



Cannabis accounting experience is NOT required. We can teach the industry-specific accounting requirements. Strong bookkeeping fundamentals and extensive QuickBooks Desktop experience are much more important.



PLEASE INCLUDE THE FOLLOWING WITH YOUR APPLICATION:



How many years have you worked with QuickBooks Desktop?

Have you manually entered an entire month of transactions into QuickBooks Desktop directly from bank and/or credit card statements?

Are you comfortable determining the appropriate general ledger account for transactions rather than simply accepting imported classifications?

What experience do you have with bank and credit card reconciliations?

Are you able to consistently work from 10:00 AM to 6:30 PM U.S. Eastern Time, with a break for lunch?



Please begin your proposal with the words "QUICKBOOKS DESKTOP" so we know you have read the entire posting.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Job Title: Operations Manager (Part-Time, Remote — Philippines)

Company: By The 10th, an emerging AI-powered accounting and bookkeeping firm

Compensation: $8.00 USD/hour, part-time to start but expected full time shortly, with hour growth tied to client acquisition milestones (details below)

Location: Remote (Philippines-based)



About Us

We're an early-stage, technology-driven CPA and bookkeeping firm combining AI automation with expert oversight to deliver fast, accurate, and affordable accounting services to small businesses and property owners. We're building the operational backbone now, and we're looking for a detail-oriented Operations Manager to grow with us from day one.



Role Overview

As our first Operations Manager, you'll own the day-to-day operational infrastructure that keeps the firm running smoothly — client onboarding, scheduling, internal systems, and process documentation — while working closely with the founder as the client base scales. This is a foundational role with real upside: as we grow, your hours and compensation grow with it.



Key Responsibilities

- Manage client onboarding workflows (intake forms, document collection, welcome sequences)

- Maintain and improve internal SOPs and process documentation as the firm scales

- Coordinate scheduling for client calls, deadlines, and deliverables

- Monitor and manage shared inboxes/communication channels for timely client responses

- Assist with CRM/practice management software upkeep (e.g., client records, task tracking)

- Support basic bookkeeping-adjacent admin tasks (invoicing, file organization, deadline tracking)

- Help implement and refine AI tools/workflows used in service delivery

- Flag bottlenecks or inefficiencies and propose process improvements

- Prepare periodic reports on client volume, turnaround times, and operational KPIs

- Help with sending out financials by the 10th of the month .



Requirements

- 5+ years of experience in operations, executive assistance, or administrative management (accounting/bookkeeping firm experience a plus, not required)

- Strong written English communication skills

- Comfortable with tools like Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Slack, QuickBooks Online, and general SaaS platforms (we'll train on our specific stack)

- Highly organized, self-directed, and comfortable in an early-stage, evolving environment

- Reliable internet connection and a quiet remote work setup

- Available during a set overlap window with US business hours (9AM to 5PM MST)



Compensation & Growth Structure

Starting rate: $8/hour, part-time based on the number of clients we acquire.

Performance-based raises independent of the client-count schedule are also possible with annual review.



To Apply

Reply to this job post with "Ops Expert" in the subject line.

In your response, answer these questions:

- what is your relevant operations experience?

- what is your availability?

- what are your preferred working hours?

- what sets you apart from other applicants?



***Applications that do NOT follow these instructions will be automatically disqualified without opening.
