title: Real Estate Advisory Analyst
description:
ABOUT MLA CANADA 

 

MLA Canada is the most comprehensive real estate service provider in Canada. Partnering with residential developers, MLA Canada offers an unmatched level of expertise in advisory services, market intelligence, project marketing, sales, customer care and administration. From boutique projects to large masterplan communities, our diverse and deeply experienced service teams deliver exceptional results while placing our clients’ objectives and brand identity first.  

 



WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT 



We are driven to change the way the world purchases real estate. Our company is at the helm of an exciting transition of growth in technology and innovation, and the market intelligence our Advisory team gathers sits at the centre of it. As we take on this exciting challenge, we are seeking a Real Estate Advisory Analyst to join our Advisory department. You will own the accuracy and timeliness of MLA Canada’s Metro Vancouver market database in HubSpot and our rental tracker in Excel. This is a detail-driven research and data entry role for someone with real estate industry experience; knowledge of and experience in the presale real estate market is preferred. This role reports to the Advisory Manager and collaborates with our Advisory, Sales and Marketing teams to keep the intelligence behind every MLA Canada recommendation current and reliable. 



This is a full-time remote position and international candidates are welcome. Working hours are 8 hours per day, Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific Time, and teammates are expected to be available and responsive throughout those hours. 



The core responsibilities for the role will be, but are not limited to: 

Complete monthly HubSpot update cycles for all Metro Vancouver markets using Zonda Urban and intel gathered from MLA Canada competitive site tours and phone calls 

Monitor incoming intel from teams chats and
. Input intel from the Advisory alias
 inbox daily and enter every update, including intel from our sales team channels, into the correct HubSpot project record 

Update the Excel rental tracker monthly by researching online rental listings in new buildings across 12 submarkets, capturing project name, developer, unit mix, sizing and pricing 

Update quarterly completion statuses based on online construction updates, available rental and MLS listings, and on-the-ground research provided by the Advisory Manager 

Keep data clean by following MLA Canada formats and naming conventions, cross-checking before overwriting, and flagging gaps or conflicts 

Maintain MLA Canada’s Market Intelligence database so findings can be proactively input into client deliverables 

Work with cross-functional teams including sales and marketing to ensure market intelligence reaches the right people at the right time 

Support the Advisory department company initiatives 





WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE 



2+ years of experience in real estate (research, brokerage, development, valuation or property management) 

Fluency in residential real estate concepts; knowledge of the presale market is preferred 

Proven accuracy in high-volume data entry 

Strong Excel skills and CRM experience (HubSpot and Zonda Urban familiarity is an asset, and we will train) 

Strong written English 

A personal cellphone and computer with access to reliable internet during working hours 

Ability to produce results independently while maintaining a positive team environment 

Self-directed and reliable on monthly cycles with minimal supervision 

An amazing attention to detail with an ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment 

Time management skills while working under pressure with multiple projects and timelines 



APPLICATION CHALLENGE (REQUIRED) 



 We will send you an Excel file of our past rental research for Burnaby, BC. Find 15 to 20 current listings that are new this month (not already in the file) from purpose-built rental buildings only, with no more than 3 per building. Add them to the spreadsheet in the same format as the existing rows, with a working URL for every listing, and submit it with your application. We evaluate accuracy, working links, genuinely new listings and format match, not speed. Expect 1 to 2 hours.  

 



WHY IT’S SO GREAT TO WORK FOR MLA 



MLA offers individuals an unparalleled opportunity to work with a growing company with a clear vision to be Canada’s undisputed leader in real estate, and to be a part of setting a new standard of excellence for experience and innovation in the world of new home sales. 



Our core values are at the heart of our people and company objectives. We strive to live Together We Win, Commit to the MLA Experience, Innovation Drives Value and Deliver Results. 



We celebrate our wins and each other. We are committed to fostering a rich learning organization and mapping out career paths based on individual talents and goals. We are big on fostering a community based on trust, respect and creating a fun and collaborative place to be! 



 

In addition to a competitive compensation structure, we offer: 



An amazing opportunity for mentorship - we are committed to investing in our team  

On-going commitment to training, personal growth and development  

An opportunity to work with the best of the business  

A collaborative, innovative and fun working environment 

Opportunities for educational and professional growth

title: Streamer Outreach Reps
description:
Royale Arcade is hiring: Streamer Outreach Reps (Remote, Commission-Based)



We’re a studio making slot games and we don’t care about platform etiquette. We just want streamers playing our slots on stream. If you’re willing to ignore chat rules, spam, and push until they play, we want you.

What you’ll do



Hunt down any live streamer with an audience (Twitch, Kick, YouTube Live — doesn’t matter if they normally play slots or not).

Flood their chat, DMs, 
,
/X, whatever works. Keep messaging until they try our slots.

When they play, grab a clip of the session and submit it for your payout.

Track who you’ve hit so we can scale volume. No soft limits.



How you get paid



Payout for every streamer you get to play our slots on stream (verified by your clip). Based on live viewer count at the time they play:



Under 100 viewers: $5

100–999: $20

1,000–4,999: $60

5,000+: $150



One payout per streamer goes to the first valid clip submitted.

Minimum play requirement



Streamer has to play at least 10 minutes on stream. That’s it.

Clip requirements



Clearly shows them playing a Royale Arcade slot

Shows channel name + viewer count

Submitted within 24 hours with stream/VOD link



Outreach style we actually want



Do not identify as a Royale Arcade rep unless it helps.

Spam is fine. Multiple messages, different accounts, tag them, drop links, whatever gets them to load the game.

Ignore chat rules, slow-mode, bans, platform ToS. Just get the play.

Target anyone with eyes on their stream — gambling creators, variety streamers, just chatting, IRL, doesn’t matter. Adults preferred but volume comes first.

No “polite one message and leave.” Persistence is the job.



Who we’re looking for



Comfortable with Twitch/Kick/YouTube culture and not scared of getting timed out or banned.

Thick-skinned, pushy, and results-focused.

Organized enough to track outreach and clip fast.

18+ (or legal age wherever you are).

Ashoori Law | Full-Time | Remote | Independent Contractor



Independent Contractor Notice



This is a full-time independent contractor position, not an employee position. The selected candidate will be responsible for their own taxes, registrations, and compliance obligations in their jurisdiction.



About Ashoori Law



Ashoori Law is a U.S.-based immigration law firm serving individuals, families, entrepreneurs, investors, and businesses with their U.S. immigration needs.



We are seeking an experienced Marketing Director to lead our marketing strategy, strengthen lead generation, improve conversion performance, and drive measurable business growth.



Position Overview



The Marketing Director will own the firm’s overall marketing strategy and performance. This role will oversee paid advertising, lead-generation funnels, HubSpot CRM and automation, website optimization, content strategy, analytics, and marketing attribution.



You will work directly with firm leadership and manage marketing agencies, contractors, media buyers, developers, designers, and content creators.



We are looking for a strategic leader who is also comfortable working hands-on with marketing data, systems, and execution.



Key ResponsibilitiesMarketing Strategy & Growth



Develop and execute the overall marketing and growth strategy

Establish marketing goals, KPIs, budgets, and performance targets

Identify opportunities to increase qualified leads, consultations, client acquisition, and revenue

Provide strategic recommendations and regular performance updates to leadership

Paid Advertising & Lead Generation



Oversee paid advertising across Google, Meta, YouTube, and other relevant platforms

Manage agencies, media buyers, and advertising vendors

Optimize advertising budgets, lead quality, cost per lead, and cost per booked consultation

Identify opportunities to scale high-performing acquisition channels

Funnel & Conversion Optimization



Own and improve the lead-to-consultation marketing funnel

Optimize landing pages, intake forms, follow-up systems, and consultation booking flows

Identify conversion bottlenecks and implement improvements

Develop testing strategies to improve conversion rates

HubSpot CRM & Automation



Oversee HubSpot CRM, marketing automation, and lead lifecycle management

Build and optimize
 sequences, workflows, and lead-nurturing systems

Improve lead follow-up and consultation booking rates

Ensure accurate lead tracking, attribution, and reporting

Website & Content



Oversee website performance, user experience, and conversion optimization

Coordinate improvements with developers, designers, SEO specialists, and other vendors

Lead content and digital marketing strategy

Ensure consistent, professional messaging across marketing channels

Team & Vendor Management



Lead and coordinate marketing agencies, contractors, vendors, and team members

Establish clear goals, deadlines, KPIs, and performance expectations

Evaluate performance and hold marketing partners accountable for results

Identify additional resources or capabilities needed to support growth

Reporting & Analytics



Track and report key marketing metrics, including:



Qualified leads and lead quality

Cost per lead and cost per booked consultation

Consultation booking and funnel conversion rates

Customer acquisition cost

Marketing-sourced revenue

Revenue attribution

ROAS and overall marketing ROI

Use performance data to recommend where marketing resources and budgets should be increased, reduced, or reallocated.



Required Qualifications



10+ years of progressive marketing experience, including senior-level marketing leadership

Proven experience developing and leading marketing strategies that generated measurable growth

Strong experience with paid advertising, lead generation, and conversion optimization

Advanced experience with HubSpot CRM and marketing automation

Strong understanding of marketing analytics, attribution, budgeting, and ROI

Experience managing marketing teams, agencies, contractors, and vendors

Ability to analyze performance data and translate it into actionable business decisions

Excellent communication, organization, and project management skills

Highly accountable, proactive, and results-oriented

Comfortable working directly with senior leadership in a remote environment

Preferred Qualifications



Previous experience as a Marketing Director, Head of Marketing, VP of Marketing, or similar senior marketing leader

Experience marketing legal or professional services

Experience with immigration law firm marketing

Experience working with U.S.-based businesses

Experience managing significant paid media budgets

Familiarity with compliance-sensitive industries

Performance-based bonuses may be offered based on measurable marketing results and growth.

title: AutoCAD Draftsman — German Architectural Floor Plans (metric / DIN standards), ongoing work
description:
We are a German drafting service and we are looking for an AutoCAD draftsman to produce architectural floor plans to German standards, on an ongoing basis.



This is not a one-off gig. We want to build a working relationship with one or two reliable people and send work their way continuously as our order volume grows.



What we do



We prepare CAD drawings for private clients, architects and planning offices in Germany. We handle the client, the site information and the full specification. You do the drawing.



A typical job: a client gives us a hand sketch, a survey, an existing plan or a set of measurements of a house. We turn that into a complete, dimensioned specification. You turn our specification into a clean DWG and a print-ready PDF that looks like it came out of a German architecture office.



Typical projects are detached houses, bungalows, apartments and small commercial units, usually 80 – 250 m², ground floor plans and occasionally upper floors. Scale 1:100 or 1:50, sheets DIN A3 or A2.



What the work involves

- Floor plans (Grundriss) — walls, openings, dimension chains, room stamps, furniture

- Occasionally as-built drawings from measured surveys

- Occasionally sections and elevations

- Always 2D. We do not need 3D modelling, rendering or visualisation.



Deliverables for every job:



- .dwg in AutoCAD 2018 format — drawn 1:1 in metres in model space, purged and audited, no xrefs, no proxy objects, nothing on layer 0, dimensions as real dimension objects and never exploded into lines and text

- .pdf — vector, true to scale, monochrome, with line weights plotted

- A short room schedule as a spreadsheet



What you need to be able to do



1. Work entirely in metric. Metres and centimetres. If your drafting experience is in feet and inches, this job is not for you — please do not apply.



2. Work to German drawing conventions. They differ from US and UK practice in specific ways. The most important ones:



- Dimension lines are terminated with a 45° oblique tick, never with an arrowhead

- The decimal separator is a comma: 3,99 — never 3.99

- Dimension text sits above the line, in metres with two decimals, readable from the bottom and from the right

- Dimension chains run in three parallel rows per façade, ordered from the building outwards: openings, then walls and rooms, then the overall dimension — and every chain has to close exactly

- Differentiated line weights: 0,50 mm for cut walls, 0,35 mm for visible edges, 0,25 mm for dimension lines, 0,13 – 0,18 mm for hatching. A drawing where every line has the same weight is not acceptable.

- 45° hatching on cut masonry, at a spacing that actually reads on the printed sheet

- A disciplined layer structure, everything set to ByLayer

- Text in a TrueType font so that German characters (ä ö ü ß) render correctly



You do not need to know these conventions by heart. We supply a written brief of about 6.000 words in English that specifies every one of them: layer names, line weights, text heights, dimension style settings, hatch patterns, title block content and a final self-check list. But you need to be the kind of drafter who can follow a specification to the millimetre. That is the core of this job.



3. Draw clean geometry. Closed polylines, no gaps at wall junctions, no duplicate lines, no overshoots. We check this.



4. Communicate in written English. You do not need to speak German. All German text that appears on the drawing — room names, notes, title block — is supplied as ready-to-copy strings.



What you get from us



We do not send vague requests. Before you start a job you receive:



1. The full written brief with every drawing convention specified

2. A dimensionally verified schematic from us — every dimension chain already closed, with a door schedule and a window schedule giving the exact position of every opening from a defined origin point, and the furniture layout with sizes

3. All site information



There are no design decisions for you to make and nothing to guess. If something in our package is ambiguous, you ask and we answer — that is on us, not on you.



How we start



The first assignment is a small paid test task of about two hours — one band of rooms with walls, openings, one dimension chain and one room stamp. Paid at your normal rate. It tells both of us within a day whether the conventions work out, before either side commits to a full project.



After that, the first full project is roughly 15 hours of work.



On volume, honestly: we are a young business and growing. We are not going to promise you a guaranteed number of hours every week, because we cannot. What we can say is that we intend to send every suitable job to the same person, and that we pay on time, every time.



Please do NOT apply if

- You work primarily in feet and inches

- Your portfolio is renderings, 3D models and visualisations rather than dimensioned working drawings

- You cannot show work you have drawn yourself

- You need a guaranteed full-time workload right now



A straight "this is not my kind of work" costs you nothing and we will remember you positively.



HOW TO APPLY — please read, this d
 it



1. Start your message with the word MASSKETTE. It is German for "dimension chain". It tells us you read the post rather than mass-applying. Applications without it are not read.



2. Attach one or two PDFs of dimensioned floor plans you have drawn yourself. Not renderings. Not 3D views. Working drawings with dimension chains, room labels and a title block. This is by far the most important part of your application — it tells us more than any description.



We will look at exactly these things in your sample:



- Do the dimension chains close, and are they complete?

- Are the line weights differentiated, or is everything one weight?

- Is the drawing in metric?

- Is the layer structure clean?

- Does the sheet look finished — title block, legend, north arrow, room stamps?



3. Answer these four questions, briefly:



a) Which countries' standards have you drawn to? If you have worked on German, Austrian, Swiss or other European projects, say so and say which office or client — that moves you to the front of the queue.



b) What is your hourly rate for this work, and roughly how many hours would you estimate for a furnished 150 m² single-storey floor plan at 1:100 on A3?



c) What does your capacity look like right now — how many hours per day, and which days?



d) Which CAD software do you own and use? (AutoCAD, BricsCAD, Revit, ArchiCAD — tell us the actual version.)



4. If you have a current project running and could start within the next few days, say so. We have work waiting right now.



Thank you for reading this far. We know it is a long post — that is deliberate. We would rather have five applications from people who fit than fifty from people who do not.



Sander Marquardt Zeichenpartner, Germany

title: Graphic Designer
description:
We are a growing U.S.-based creative agency and consulting practice dedicated to empowering faith-based organizations, ministries, and mission-driven entities. The Graphic Designer creates polished, high-impact visual assets tailored for Black churches, ministries, faith-based conferences, podcasts, and mission-driven organizations. In this role, you will transform creative briefs into engaging designs, adapt visual tones for diverse congregational and community audiences, maintain organized digital asset workflows, and refine work based on collaborative feedback.



Responsibilities



- Create church, conference, event, podcast, social, and campaign graphics. 

- Develop distinctly different visual directions rather than applying one template to every client. 

- Adapt approved designs into requested sizes. 

- Use supplied photographs respectfully and preserve accurate skin tones. 

- Follow brand standards, accessibility requirements, deadlines, and file-naming rules. 

- Disclose templates, stock assets, and generative AI used in client work. 



Qualifications:



- Portfolio demonstrating strong typography, photo treatment, hierarchy, and event promotion. 

- Proficiency in Canva Pro, Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma, or comparable tools. 

- Ability to receive detailed feedback and make controlled revisions. 

- Strong written English and dependable online communication. 

- Black church experience is preferred; demonstrated ability to learn the BMC standard is required. 



Work begins on a freelance and project-based basis, and there are no guaranteed minimum hours or workload at launch.



Our agency's intent is to provide strong, dependable performers with increasing assignments, transitioning into steady part-time work, and eventually full-time employment as recurring client revenue and workload support it. Please note that this is a potential growth trajectory based on performance and agency capacity—no applicant is promised a specific conversion date, minimum workload, or guaranteed full-time position.



Evaluation Task Policy



During the selection process, applicants may be invited to complete a brief sample design assignment.



- Fictional & Evaluation-Only: Each task is fictional and unpaid, used exclusively to evaluate the applicant’s skills. 

- Usage Protections: Completed task work will never be published, sold, repurposed, shown to a client, or incorporated into paid client work. 

- Respect for Time: Applicants will not be asked to exceed the stated time limit for the assignment, and candidates are encouraged to watermark all visual submissions. 





Application Requirements



To be considered for this role, all of the following materials must be submitted together:



1. Current Résumé

2. Portfolio link or sample assets

3. Answers to application screening questions

4. Proposed freelance rates/fees

6. Completed application evaluation task -

description:
Growth Marketing Lead | Meta Ads + CRM + Funnel Optimization



We are looking for a senior, hands-on Growth Marketing Lead to help grow a local wellness business in Utah.

This is not primarily a social media, content, or basic media-buying role.

We are a location-based membership business with significant unused capacity, so profitable recurring membership growth is the primary objective.



Your responsibility is to help us improve the entire customer growth funnel:

Traffic → First Purchase → Visit → Second Visit → Membership → Retention → Referral



We already have:

- An operations lead

- An in-location manager

- A marketing/CRM execution team member

- Existing franchise marketing resources



You will own growth strategy and experimentation, including d
 what to test, prioritizing the work, directing our marketing execution resource, and measuring whether it is working.



Areas you may own

- Personally managing Meta campaigns, including campaign setup, audience strategy, budget allocation, optimization, creative testing, and performance analysis

- Customer segmentation and positioning

- Offers and landing pages

- Funnel/conversion optimization

- CAC, LTV and cohort analysis

- Tracking and attribution

-
/SMS lifecycle strategy

- First-visit and second-visit conversion

- Membership conversion

- Reactivation

- Retention and referrals

- Directing our existing marketing execution resource



This is a hands-on role. You will personally manage our paid media campaigns, especially during the initial 30–90 days, while directing other team members for CRM,
, SMS, reporting, and implementation support.  

We are looking for someone who can both execute where needed and operate at a higher level by diagnosing problems, prioritizing experiments, directing the team, and owning growth outcomes.



Initial engagement

We will begin with a paid 30-day trial. Your first objective will be to:

1. Understand our current funnel and customer economics.

2. Establish baseline metrics.

3. Identify the largest constraint to membership growth.

4. Prioritize and launch growth experiments.

5. Direct our existing team in execution.

6. Create a simple weekly growth scorecard.

7. Recommend the next 60–90 days.



If the fit is strong, this can become an ongoing and increasingly important role.

Expected capacity is approximately 20–25 hours per week.

Compensation is approximately $1,500–$2,500 USD/month depending on experience.



This is an outcome-oriented role rather than an hourly task-based position. We care more about ownership, judgment, experimentation, and measurable growth than hours logged.



To apply, please answer these questions

1. Give us 2–3 examples of growth initiatives you personally led.

For each include:

- The business/product

- The problem

- What you changed

- Actual results before and after

- What you personally owned

Include metrics such as CAC, conversion rate, revenue, ROAS, LTV, retention, or recurring revenue where possible.



2. Scenario

A local wellness business sells a first visit for $45.

Paid acquisition currently costs approximately $100–$130 per first-time purchaser. Most first-time customers do not return, membership conversion is low, and there is significant unused capacity.

You have an operations lead, an in-location manager, and a team member available to execute CRM/email/SMS work.

What would you investigate first, and what would your first 30 days look like?

Keep your response concise.



3. Include

- Current location/time zone

- Weekly availability

- Desired compensation

- Earliest start date



Please organize your application using the three sections above and keep it concise.

We value clear thinking and specific results over polished presentation.

 and calls for the CEO and COO, filtering priorities and drafting professional correspondence on their behalf

Represent Mainspring's leadership professionally in all communications. Anticipate needs before they're expressed. Follow through on every commitment without being chased. 



What We're Looking For 

Essential :

- Proven experience supporting senior executives 

- Exceptional written English skills

- Experience working independently and making appropriate decisions under pressure

title: Credit Commando - Remote
description:
Variable compensation ranging from $800 ~ $2,400+/month (USD) + available commissions based on speed, proficiency, quality, relevant experience, & more.



Ascend Prime Wealth is hiring a Credit Commando to join our rapidly expanding team. 

This role is for high-performers who know credit inside and out, and who thrive in direct, client-facing interactions.



About the Role

As a Credit Commando, you’ll be the primary guide for our clients: analyzing their credit reports, prescribing action steps, building funding plans, and walking them through every stage with clarity and confidence. You will manage 5~30+ clients simultaneously while making each one feel supported and understood.



We’re looking for someone sharp, professional, and fluent in English - someone who can make clients feel comfortable while ensuring no detail is missed.



Key Responsibilities

- Review credit reports and prescribe actionable steps (repair, pay down cards, ready for funding).

- Build tailored funding plans and walk clients through them step by step.

- Onboard clients effectively, ensuring they feel welcome and supported.

- Communicate directly with clients via calls, chats, and bootcamps.

- Collect backend payments and upsell additional services.

- Capture strong client testimonials to showcase results.

- Track all accounts to ensure 100% client follow-through - no one slips through the cracks.

- Escalate and resolve client challenges quickly and effectively.

- Move new clients through the credit optimization process the same, or next day. (Should only take 30-90 minutes)



What We Offer

- Growth Potential: Join a company scaling rapidly and grow into leadership opportunities.

- Proven Playbooks: Access battle-tested frameworks, trainings, and live bootcamps to succeed.

- Client-Facing Role: Become the trusted advisor and face of Legacy Strong for your clients.

- Team Support: Work with a team ready to back you up on escalations and complex cases.



Required Qualifications

- Credit Experience (Mandatory): Must have proven experience reading credit reports, and building funding strategies (applications without this will not be reviewed).

- Client-Facing Experience: Skilled at communicating with clients, building trust, and guiding them through complex processes.

- Strong English Proficiency: Excellent verbal and written English required.

- Organization & Attention to Detail: Ability to manage 30+ clients simultaneously without errors.

- Sales/Customer Service Experience: Comfortable upselling, guiding, and managing long-term client relationships.

- Must be available full time during US hours 7AM PST - 5PM PST



Preferred Qualifications

- Background in both credit repair and funding.

- Experience with onboarding processes and gathering testimonials.

- Indistinguishable English 



There are 3 main pillars that establish this position

1) Client Success Manager - Onboard clients with exceptional warmth and excitement, celebrating the beginning of their journey, and making them feel truly welcomed and fully supported in their journey of credit optimization and funding. (This should feel like top tier - world class customer service, as if you are staying at the finest hotels in a major city, where every little thing is fully taken care of for you.) - Exceptional relationship building skills are necessary - first impressions matter.



2) Credit Disputes - follow a proven copy and paste template and process, that has historically generated great success with resolving specific credit issues, such as the removal of hard inquiries, negative items, and personal information. (Speed, precision, and accuracy matters here.) - Being detail oriented, with the ability to follow instructions well, without mistakes is essential here.



3) Funding Liaison - Here you guide the client through a proven funding strategy, custom tailored to them - to help them achieve their funding goals. (In the beginning, you will be reporting directly to the admin & funding specialist team to build out strategies, and then will be guiding the client through the process with excellent relationship skills - ensuring that they are feeling valued, respected, and delighted throughout the process - leveraging professionalism, personal-connection, and speed.)



How to Apply

Subject Line: “Golden Ticket”



Please send:

1) Your resume

2) A short description of your credit/funding experience

3) One paragraph on how you’ve successfully managed multiple clients while keeping them fully supported

4) A quick 1-2 minute video including:

- A little bit about you

- Your passions

- Why you want the job

- Relevant experience

- Anything else good/important to add



Please also include your desired compensation.



Location: Remote position open to candidates based in Latin America and Philippines



Ready to help us build something exceptional?

We look forward to hearing from you!



Contact: Alan Nguyen , CEO | Ascend Prime Wealth

description:
